runtime_proof.additional: ops:proof-rebind preview run against two real bundles; --apply was never used and git status reported both proof directories clean afterwards. The PR-1311 lane bundle returns proof_rebind_refused (canonical '## Merge SHA Binding' section absent; sha256_before == sha256_after for both artifacts). The PR-1313 lane bundle returns proof_rebind_preview with errors: [] and exactly five binding changes, with the line count unchanged, only the declared lines differing, the verified_source_note narrative byte-identical, and the out-of-section narrative row 'Merge SHA: pending merge. This bundle is bound to ...' untouched. The previous revision's proof described the PR-1313 bundle as refused for carrying explanatory prose; that statement was wrong and is retracted. Both contracts are pinned as tests that read the bundles from commit 2822b709c74c43dc24a50dc6df35597e1a0463fe via git show, so they cannot change meaning if either bundle is later legitimately rebound.
